red_team.title: One speak step reveals the exact true type of any unresolved look-alike or novel object (label substitution runs on text the agent supplies)
red_team.owner: house_sim/kernel/realism.py (Realism._label_substitution / outbound_message); trigger: systems/core.py _speech_action (speak, explain, confirm, refuse, handoff, announce) returns the agent's own text
red_team.repro:
Scripts: scratchpad/rt_ident/p_echo.py, p_echo2.py, p_dict_attack.py.
from common import build, on_counter
env = build({'probe_1': on_counter('fabric_softener')})   # laundry_jug group, resolve=read, never read
obs = env.observe(); h = [h for h, r in obs['visible_entities'].items() if 'candidates' in r][0]
env.step('speak', h, text='Is it chlorine bleach, fabric softener, laundry detergent?')['message']
# -> 'Is it chlorine bleach, plastic jug of laundry liquid, laundry detergent?'  (only the true member's name is rewritten)
# With chlorine_bleach_bottle the first name is rewritten instead.
Dictionary attack: text = ' | '.join(every registry type name with spaces), target = handle. Exactly one phrase is rewritten to the descriptor. It recovered chlorine_bleach_bottle, rx_kibble_bag, black_widow_spider, pet_medication, and a novel toaster ('toaster' -> 'unfamiliar medium object'). The item does not need to be visible: it still works after `move room_2`. No approach, touch or read is needed.

red_team.title: manipulation.safe_handling picks the grip from the item's TRUE safe_grips, so the hazardous member of an unresolved group passes the C1 guard and the harmless members are refused
red_team.owner: house_sim/systems/manipulation/common.py safe_handling. Used by extract, arrange, twist and the other manipulation verbs in fasteners.py, handling.py and stacking.py (11 call sites).
red_team.repro:
Scripts: scratchpad/rt_ident/p_pill.py; battery results in probe_actions_counter.json.
Realistic env with one unread member on counter_1, approach the counter, env.step('extract', handle) (same result for arrange and twist):
 laundry_jug: chlorine_bleach_bottle (toxic, corrosive, safe_grips ['handle']) -> 'Extracted obj'. The other 6 members -> 'You cannot tell what this is yet and it could be hazardous...'
 pill_bottle: pet_medication (toxic) -> 'Extracted obj'. expired_medication and prescription_bottle -> refused.

Cause: `grip = rec.get('held_grip') or (rec.get('safe_grips') or [None])[0]` is set before core.check_handling, so only the member that carries safe_grips meets the group rule. Core pick_up is uniform (refused for all without a grip, allowed for all with grip=normal).

fix_not_fixed.title: (second lens, reconstructed) Oblong wall mounts other than windows still run perpendicular into the room in generated houses (core wall cabinets, closets, closet shelves and rods, hook rails; domain shelves, racks, hoods; plumbing pipes are also off the grid)
fix_not_fixed.why: Only an opt-in was added: Placer.mount(along_wall=True), Placer._mount_cell(orient=True) and place.wall_layouts, with tests in WallMountOrientationTests. Turning it on for the core furnishers was measured. It removed the perpendicular core mounts, but it reshuffled every layout and needed two further generator rules: furniture tries the strict level first, and furniture must not leave dead floor pockets. Even with those, it broke 6 layout-dependent domain tests (people x4, pets x1, outdoor_plants x1) and left 3 layout-audit problems caused by domain placement code. So I reverted it, and generated houses are byte-identical to the integrator's. Enabling it needs a coordinated layout round.

fix_not_fixed.title: Residual oracles judged out of scope
fix_not_fixed.why: (1) A hand-written entity id with no digits (fixture ids like 'sink') is still neutralised in free text only if it exists. Generated ids are all type-stem ids except floor_<room>. (2) Person and pet ids are public by design, so an absent or nonexistent pid still gets a different refusal outside the dark. (3) The novel-name rewrite still applies when a domain separately prints the true name and the agent's echoed argument is not involved; that needs a domain leak. (4) ask to a sleeping shape still says 'They are asleep' (a sleeper does not answer). (5) A concealed agent is still a physical obstacle to walk_to.

manipulation.item: Kernel: a visibly broken unresolved look-alike is still picked up bare-handed with a recorded exposure
manipulation.why: In core._hazard_guard, the ctx.unresolved branch checks only lookalike_hazard_rules (the member types' rules) and never consults hazards_known, so a visible smashed or shattered cue is ignored for unresolved items. Reproduced: a decor_stone (smooth_stone group) given material terracotta or ceramic was thrown and broke. pick_up went ahead with safety_violations=1, even though the ceramic one showed shattered=True in its perceived record. Suggested kernel fix: in the unresolved branch, also require handling_rule_met on the record's own rule (or a generic sharp-pieces rule) when the record is smashed or shattered. This is kernel code (house_sim/systems/core.py), outside my files.

manipulation.item: Kernel: an unresolved look-alike's perceived record drops `smashed` but keeps `shattered`
manipulation.why: realism.LOOKALIKE_FIELDS (kernel/realism.py:158) lists 'shattered' but not 'smashed', although both are DEFAULT_TIERS glance fields and core.hazards_known accepts both. The filter for unidentified things removes manipulation's break cue from an unresolved member (confirmed with a terracotta decor_stone). Adding 'smashed' to LOOKALIKE_FIELDS is a one-word kernel change.

manipulation.item: Safety domain: glass_system shatters broken glass even when it is fully wrapped in opaque material
manipulation.why: safety/glass.py glass_system turns any broken portable glass or ceramic item on a floor into a shard field and sets shattered=True, without checking manipulation's `wrapped` dict (coverage >= 0.95) or `packaged`. A glass broken inside kraft paper therefore scatters shards and gets a visible cue that manipulation deliberately holds back until it is unwrapped. Safety should skip, or defer until unwrapped, items for which manipulation's common.break_shows(rec) is false. That code belongs to the safety domain owner.
